name: Rockslide
description: Loosen a slope of rock above the foes and let it pour down in a grinding rush.

name: Bedrock Shoulder
description: Raise a heavy shoulder of rock between user and foe to take the full weight of a charge.

name: Boulder Rain
description: Lift a cloud of boulders high and let them fall across the field in a thudding rain.

name: Leaden Step
description: Step with the weight of a falling stone so the ground gives under each foot and flings the body on.

name: Leaning Weight
description: Let a rising peak lean slowly onto the foe until its weight rests on them wholly.

name: Toppled Giant
description: Bring a giant's shape of stone down on the target and flatten it into the ground.

name: Stone Mantle
description: Wear a mantle of heavy stone that turns most blows and lends the wearer a giant's strength.

name: Cleaving Upthrust
description: Raise a sharp ridge from the ground and run it through the ranks like a plough through soil.

name: Colossal Heave
description: Heave a section of mountainside into the air and fling it down across the opposing ranks.

name: Crown Breaker
description: Break the top off a standing peak with the qi field and drop the broken summit on one target.

name: Colossus Palm
description: Close a palm of mountain stone down on the foes and hold them under its weight.

name: Toppling Mass
description: Bring a peak down whose weight and spread follow the qi poured into it and leave the ground beneath it pinned.

name: Crushing Cataclysm
description: Topple a whole mountain onto the field so its fall flattens all in reach up to the destructive ceiling of this tier.

name: Strata Break
description: Crack the top layers of ground in a wide web so the foes' footing splits open.

name: Sunder Guard
description: Open a narrow rift before the user into which a charge or a blast falls and is lost.

name: Layer Pull
description: Pull the upper layer of ground sideways so the foes' feet go with it and they fall.

name: Stratum Step
description: Drop through one layer and rise through the next to cross unseen under a short stretch of ground.

name: Sundering Palm
description: Strike so the blow splits layers of armor and bone as the ground itself splits.

name: Strata Press
description: Press two layers of rock together over a crowd until they cannot rise from the ground.

name: Bedrock Split
description: Split the bedrock in a long line and heave both halves apart under the foes' feet.

name: Layered Mantle
description: Wrap the body in many thin layers of rock that peel away one by one as blows land.

name: Deep Rend
description: Rend the ground down to its deep roots across the front and fling the pieces skyward.

name: Strata Collapse
description: Undermine the layers beneath a large host and let the whole body of ground sink in.

name: Opening Fault
description: Open an old fault line from end to end so that the land on either side lurches apart.

name: Sundered Crown
description: Sunder the stone beneath one foe and drop a broken crown of rock on them with a force that rises with the core's reserve.

name: Strata Sundering
description: Part every layer of the ground across the field so the surface and all upon it fall to the ceiling of a Core-tier master.

name: Stratum Ruin
description: Pull the layers out from under a whole region at once so it caves in as far as the master's core can reach.

name: Final Tremor
description: Send one last sharp tremor along the ground that ends every footing it passes under.

name: Quake Ward
description: Hold a ring of settled ground about the user that calms any shaking that enters it.

name: Ending Step
description: Step so that the ground behind the heel goes still and the pursuer finds no footing.

name: Stillness Press
description: Press a heavy stillness on the area until no limb in it can move.

name: Quake Fist
description: Strike so a full quake rolls through the foe's body and out into the ground behind.

name: Long Quake
description: Hold a long deep quake that keeps rolling across the field for as many breaths as the user can bear.

name: Settled Earth
description: Settle the earth about allies so that no shaking disturbs them and their strikes carry weight.

name: Breaking Stamp
description: Stamp once with the full divine weight and break the ground in a ring about the user.

name: Great Quake
description: Gather a great quake in the deep rock and release it across the whole field in one long roll.

name: Quake Crown
description: Set a crown of quake about a host so the ground heaves in a circle and holds them in it.

name: Last Foundation
description: Lay a last deep foundation under the user and allies that no quake or blow can move.

name: Ending Quake
description: Loose a quake with no echo that shakes the field once with a force that rises with the divine energy poured into it.

name: Eternal Tremor
description: Set a tremor in the deep rock that goes on shaking and pins the ground for a span that follows the energy put in.

name: Worldquake
description: Shake the whole land in one stroke and bring down everything standing on it to the destructive ceiling of a divine master.

name: Earthrend
description: Tear the earth open from surface to deep root across the front and leave no standing structure within the master's reach.
